name: Invulnerable
source:
Your character, Marcus, is still trying to figure out the Do’s and Don'ts of his superpowers. He’s only recently got them and is also trying to come to terms with the fact that he needs to convert every woman on the planet into his willing supporter. He’s got a long way to go before World Domination. 

His Dad has just left, making him the strongest superhero nobody knows about. He’s got to get stronger, corrupt and more. You’ll kidnap the villains and put them into a dungeon where you’ll take it upon yourself (as judge, jury and executioner) to reform them into mindless sex slaves. Sounds fun. 

[From [url=https://swagfire7games.itch.io/invulnerable]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的角色马库斯仍在试图弄清楚他的超能力该做什么和不该做什么。他最近才得到它们，并且还试图接受这样一个事实：他需要将地球上的每个女人转变为他自愿的支持者。距离统治世界还有很长的路要走。

他的父亲刚刚离开，使他成为无人知晓的最强超级英雄。他必须变得更强大、更腐败等等。你将绑架恶棍并将他们关进地牢，在那里你将亲自（作为法官、陪审团和刽子手）将他们改造为没有头脑的性奴隶。听起来很有趣。

[来自[url=https://swagfire7games.itch.io/invulnerable]Itch.io[/url]]
